integrity.claims: Exact transformed flow, global phase semiconjugacy, and pointwise exponential phase-aligned cycle approximation are proved analytically. Symbolic and numerical tests are corroboration only.
integrity.source_priority: The source oscillator and its invariant algebraic cycle are credited to the original authors; published on-cycle physical-time laws are credited separately; priority in unindexed literature remains uncertain.

scientific_limitations: Valid only for h>0, 0<w<4, excluding the equilibrium; nonuniform as initial radius approaches zero or parameters approach the cycle-degeneration endpoint. Hypergeometric evaluation and numerical phase extraction can be ill-conditioned. Special-function reduction does not establish originality of the underlying Gauss technique.
title: Gauss-hypergeometric flow coordinates and global isochrons of an algebraic polynomial oscillator
